title: bizzi wire protocol
description: Generated from packages/protocol/src by scripts/gen-schema.ts; do not edit. The root schema validates one WebSocket text frame (ClientMsg or ServerMsg). x-methods and x-events index the per-method and per-event $defs.

subscribe.description: Replays events with seq > since (default 0), then streams live ones.

workspace.create.description: Adopt an existing directory, or create it when `create` is true.

workspace.remove.description: Removes the workspace from bizzi's registry only; files are untouched.

worktree.create.description: `git worktree add` + a new workspace (kind 'worktree') grouped under the repo workspace. Creates `branch` from `base` (default HEAD) unless it already exists.

worktree.remove.description: Removes the worktree and its workspace. Never deletes the branch; refuses on uncommitted changes unless `force`.

session.fork.description: New session continuing from the source session's conversation (agent-native fork when supported).

session.delete.description: Stop the session if needed and remove it and its events.

session.markSeen.description: Record that the user has seen the session through `seq` (spec §4 `seen_through`). Never moves backwards.

session.restart.description: Restart the agent process on the installed version at the next safe point and resume (updates.md §5).

session.set.description: A helper's permission mode can't be loosened beyond its parent's (`conflict`). `budget` replaces the session's budget (`{}` clears it); a session held for budget accepts sends again once within it.

term.snapshot.description: Recent terminal output (scrollback) as of `seq`; subscribe with `since: seq` to continue live.

fs.browse.description: Workspace picker (spec §5.2, §10): list the directories in `path` on the machine (default: the node user's home; `~` and `~/…` are expanded). Unlike fs.list this is not confined to a workspace: it runs as the node's OS user, the same trust as a terminal session. Directories and symlinks to directories only; file contents are never read. `truncated` when the listing hit the node's entry cap.

fs.complete.description: Shell-like directory completion of a partially typed absolute path (`~/re` → `repo`). `base` is the typed directory part (`~/`), so a completion's full text is `base + name + '/'`. Matches that keep the typed case come first; matching ignores case on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS, Windows). Hidden directories only when `showHidden` or the typed name starts with '.'. `limit` default 50.

fs.suggest.description: Starting points for the picker: home, common source roots that exist (~/src, ~/repo, ~/code, …), parents of existing workspaces, and git repositories one level under those that aren't workspaces yet.

agent.plan.description: Preview the steps for installing / updating / uninstalling an agent.

agent.install.description: Run a plan; progress streams as `install.progress` (global channel) with this jobId.

agent.login.description: Start a login flow as a terminal-mode session; it emits `login.prompt` / `login.completed`.

agent.setSecret.description: Store a secret (e.g. an API key) on the machine; injected into that agent's environment.

agent.migrate.description: Switch an adopted install to the recipe's preferred method (spec §7): install with the preferred method, check PATH order, re-probe login, remove the old install once no session uses it.

usage.list.description: Per-login usage; on a hub, merged across machines per account.

widgets.list.description: On a hub without machineId: every online machine's widgets.

baselines.list.description: Learned starting context per agent, model and workspace (usage.md §2). `workspaceId` narrows to one workspace; on a hub without machineId or workspaceId: every online machine's baselines.

pairing.create.description: Create a one-time pairing code for a new device or node.

themes.list.description: Custom themes (theming.md §5). Hub-stored so every device sees them; a node stores them locally.

prefs.get.description: User-wide preferences (theme choice, density); hub-local like themes.*. `prefs.set` merges and emits `prefs.updated`.

session.info.description: Adapter-reported metadata changes (agent session id assigned, model switched, …).

turn.started.description: Emitted by the core when a turn starts; echoes the user input.

turn.steered.description: Emitted by the core when input is steered into the in-flight turn.

turn.completed.description: Emitted by the adapter when the turn finishes, with the same turnId.

message.delta.description: `parentToolId` set when the text comes from a subagent started by that tool call.

question.asked.description: The agent asks the user something (Claude AskUserQuestion, Codex requestUserInput, MCP elicitation…). `text`/`options` summarize the first question for simple clients; `questions` carries the full form. Answer with `question.respond`.

context.updated.description: Current context-window occupancy (usage.md §1.2). Agents without data never emit it.

account.usage.description: Per-login usage observed during this session (rate-limit events etc.); the core republishes it globally.

session.restarting.description: The agent process is being replaced at a safe point (updates.md §5). The bizzi session carries on.

login.prompt.description: Login sessions (`agent.login`): URLs / one-time codes detected in the terminal output.

agent.raw.description: Untranslated native event, always allowed; UIs render it generically.

prefs.updated.description: User-wide preferences changed (from `prefs.set` on any device); emitted by the server that stores them.

AccountUsage.description: Per-login usage snapshot (usage.md §3.3). Merged per (agent, accountId) across machines; newest wins.

accountId.description: Stable account identity: email / account id, or an API-key fingerprint.

observedAt.description: ISO; the UI shows the age.

AgentCapabilities.description: What an agent adapter supports. UIs gate controls on this, never on the agent name.

terminal.description: Terminal mode: raw PTY in/out is available.

questions.description: The agent can ask the user structured questions (`question.asked` / `question.respond`).

account.description: e.g. account email or plan, when the agent reports it

method.description: How the binary appears to have been installed (recipe method name, e.g. 'installer', 'brew', 'npm').

onPath.description: Whether the binary is on the PATH of non-interactive shells (launchd/systemd/containers).

support.description: Whether bizzi supports this installed version (spec §7 "Supported versions"). Absent = not checked.

supportReason.description: Why `support` isn't 'ok', e.g. "OpenCode v1 is not supported; bizzi drives v2 only".

remedies.description: Confirmable fixes for `support` or for a non-preferred install method. Never run automatically.

preferredMethod.description: The recipe's preferred method on this OS (first in its method order).

realPath.description: Real path of the executable after resolving symlinks and wrapper shims.

billing.description: Billing class of the logged-in account (spec §12.3), when known.

staleSessions.description: Sessions on this machine whose agent process runs an older version than the installed one.

kind.description: upgrade: move to a supported version · migrate: switch to the preferred install method · restart-service: restart a stale shared server.

command.description: Shell command shown to the user, when there's a single one.

message.description: Optional message to the agent (e.g. why it was denied).

editedInput.description: Replacement tool input, only when the request was `editable`.

input.description: The tool input the agent wants to use (command, file edit, …).

editable.description: Whether the adapter supports `editedInput` in the decision.

options.description: Decisions this agent supports for this request.

ApprovalResolution.description: How an approval ended: a decision, or 'cancelled' when its turn ended / the node restarted first.

BillingClass.description: spec §12.3: metered = pay per token · plan = subscription windows · budgetless = inference you own.

BrowseEntry.description: A directory offered by the workspace picker (`fs.browse` / `fs.complete` / `fs.suggest`). Only directories and symlinks that resolve to directories are ever listed.

path.description: Absolute path on the machine (not symlink-resolved).

git.description: Has a `.git` entry (a repository root or a worktree).

workspaceId.description: Already registered as this bizzi workspace (compared by real path).

ContextBaseline.description: Starting context learned per (agent, model, workspace) from the first `context.updated` of earlier sessions (usage.md §2): "Codex starts at about 14k here". `tokens` is the median of recent samples.

samples.description: Samples behind the median (at most the last 10 kept).

updatedAt.description: ISO time of the newest sample.

ContextUsage.description: usage.md §1.2. `used` is the agent's own occupancy figure, never a sum of turns.

usable.description: Window minus the agent's compaction buffer, when known. Warnings key off this.

compactAt.description: Token count at which the agent compacts, when known.

categories.description: Only where the agent reports a breakdown (Claude); bizzi adds a 'bizzi' row for what it injects.

DensityPref.description: Density preference: a layout density, or `theme` to follow the theme's own.

machineId.description: For kind 'node': the machine it serves.

owner.description: The first device paired with the setup code.

Ed25519PublicJwk.description: Ed25519 public key as a JWK (`{ kty: 'OKP', crv: 'Ed25519', x }`).

status.description: Porcelain v1 XY code, e.g. " M", "??", "A ".

target.description: Agent kind, or a tool name such as 'node'.

command.description: Shell command shown to the user (already quoted).

kind.description: Memories only: fact | preference | decision | gotcha | procedure | reference | todo.

defaultAgentScope.description: Scope used when an agent writes without naming one.

overrides.description: Per source × scope overrides; shape owned by @bizzi/knowledge.

headful.description: A display/GUI session is available to agents (macOS Aqua session, or a virtual X display).

lastSeenAt.description: Set by the hub: last time the machine's node was connected.

MachineTarget.description: Routing to a machine (hub). Methods that name a session or workspace are routed by that id. Methods without one take an optional `machineId`: required when talking to a hub, ignored by a node when it matches its own machine (a different id → `not_found`).

token.description: Token from /api/auth/token for a device of kind 'node'.

OrchestrationSettings.description: Guardrails for agent-to-agent helpers (spec §12.2). Per machine, optionally overridden per workspace.

onLimit.description: What `session_start` does beyond the concurrency limits.

parentAnswersApprovals.description: Let a parent answer its helpers' approvals (default: they go to you).

treeBudgetUsd.description: Optional metered-spend cap for a whole session tree.

code.description: One-time pairing code (or the setup code). Case-insensitive; dashes/spaces ignored.

machineId.description: For kind 'node': the machine id of the node being paired.

clientUrl.description: WebSocket URLs to use from now on.

QuestionAnswers.description: Answers keyed by QuestionItem.id: an option label, several labels (multiSelect), or free text.

allowText.description: Free-text answer allowed (besides or instead of options).

RequestMsg.description: A client → server request; `params` follows the method.

ResponseOkMsg.description: A successful response; `result` is the `result:<method>` of the request with the same id.

name.description: Environment variable name, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Values are never returned.

ServeReady.description: Printed by `bizzi serve` as a single JSON line on stdout once it is listening.

url.description: WebSocket URL of the client-protocol endpoint, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:7777/ws

SessionBudget.description: Only `metered` spend counts toward `usd`; budgetless providers count tokens only (usage.md §2).

agentSessionRef.description: The agent's own id for this conversation (Claude session id, Codex thread id, OpenCode session id).

spawnedBy.description: Agent-to-agent (spec §12.1): the parent session that started this helper. Same machine for now.

scope.description: Helpers only. child: stops with its parent · detached: outlives it.

depth.description: 0 for sessions you start; parent depth + 1 for helpers (spec §12.2 depth limit).

agentVersion.description: Version of the agent process currently running this session (updates.md §2).

billing.description: Billing class of what the session runs on (spec §12.3).

budget.description: Optional cap for this session and its helpers (usage.md §2).

group.description: Fan-out group (spec §12): sessions you started together on the same task share this id.

seenThrough.description: Highest seq viewed on any device (spec §4); "done, not yet seen" = idle with lastSeq > seenThrough.

ThemeFile.description: A custom theme stored on the hub (theming.md §5); `data` is the theme JSON (shape owned by @bizzi/ui).

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over UTF-8 `authMessage(deviceId, nonce)`.

UserPrefs.description: User-wide UI preferences (theming.md §5), stored on the server the client is connected to: the hub (shared by every device) or a node in local mode. Light/dark mode is not here: it stays per device.

themeId.description: Selected theme: a built-in id or a custom theme's id (`themes.list`).

WidgetValue.description: A node-run widget's rendered value (usage.md §4). Widgets are data, never client-side code.

error.description: Set when the last run failed; the previous value (if any) is kept.

observedAt.description: ISO time of the last successful run; the UI shows staleness.

parentWorkspaceId.description: kind 'worktree': the repo workspace it was created from (UI groups it under that one).

branch.description: kind 'worktree': the branch checked out in it.

tool.description: Set for non-agent tools (e.g. 'node'); `agent` is then the agent it was installed for.

defaultAgentScope.description: Scope used when an agent writes without naming one.

overrides.description: Per source × scope overrides; shape owned by @bizzi/knowledge.

onLimit.description: What `session_start` does beyond the concurrency limits.

parentAnswersApprovals.description: Let a parent answer its helpers' approvals (default: they go to you).

treeBudgetUsd.description: Optional metered-spend cap for a whole session tree.

themeId.description: Selected theme: a built-in id or a custom theme's id (`themes.list`).

resumeRef.description: Resume an existing agent-native session (Claude session id, Codex thread id, …).

command.description: Terminal mode only: run this command (argv) instead of the agent's TUI.

group.description: Fan-out group id (spec §12), stored on the session; at most 128 characters.

result:hello.description: `machine` is the node's machine (role 'node') or the hub's own host (role 'hub').

commands.description: Slash commands / skills the agent advertises.

prompt.description: What the session is waiting on, when known (terminal heuristics, login flows).

source.description: What produced this status, for the "explain" view (landscape.md §4.3), e.g. 'osc7501', 'detector:claude-permission', 'adapter'.
